summary: Initial Expo Web preview testing for InstaPark. Encountered TWO critical web-bundling/runtime blockers. Fixed two: (1) missing babel-preset-expo dependency; (2) expo-sqlite not supported on web. A THIRD blocker remains: expo-secure-store fails at runtime on web ('ExpoSecureStore.default.getValueWithKeyAsync is not a function'), preventing admin login and all downstream flows.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login (and any auth-protected API call)
integration_issues.issue: Runtime error 'ExpoSecureStore.default.getValueWithKeyAsync is not a function' surfaces inside the login screen error banner when SIGN IN is tapped. Root cause: expo-secure-store@55.0.13 is incompatible with Expo SDK 54 (expected ~15.0.8). lib/api.js axios request interceptor calls SecureStore.getItemAsync which throws on web, causing the request to never reach the backend. Same issue will affect session restore in app/index.tsx.
babel-preset-expo was missing from node_modules / package.json. Metro web bundle failed with 'Cannot find module babel-preset-expo'. Added via `yarn add -D babel-preset-expo@55.0.21`.

expo-sqlite/web/worker.ts references missing wa-sqlite.wasm causing 'Unable to resolve module ./wa-sqlite/wa-sqlite.wasm' bundle failure on web. lib/offline.js imports expo-sqlite statically, transitively pulled in by app/(driver)/tasks.jsx. Created lib/offline.web.js stub (Metro web platform extension) to provide no-op enqueueHandover/getQueueCount/processPendingQueue on web. Also refactored lib/offline.js to lazy-require expo-sqlite via Platform.OS check.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-secure-store v55 throws at runtime on web. Either downgrade to ~15.0.8 (matches SDK 54 expectation) or wrap SecureStore calls with Platform.OS check and fall back to AsyncStorage/localStorage for web.
expo-sqlite v55 mismatched with SDK 54 (~16.0.10 expected). The wa-sqlite.wasm asset shipped with v55 path differs and breaks web bundling.

action_items: FIX expo-secure-store web compatibility: Either (a) downgrade to ~15.0.8 to match Expo SDK 54, or (b) add a web shim in lib/api.js (use localStorage on web). Without this, NO auth flow works on Expo Web.

Consider downgrading mismatched packages flagged by expo (expo-sqlite, expo-file-system, async-storage, datetimepicker, image-picker, netinfo, react-native-svg) to versions expected by SDK 54 — version mismatches are causing real runtime breakage, not just warnings.
After fixes, re-test: admin login → dashboard → create driver (capture EMP-id/PIN via Alert) → sign out → driver login → driver-home rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.js calls SecureStore.getItemAsync inside an axios request interceptor — every API request fails on web because of expo-secure-store native module mismatch. Needs Platform-aware token storage.
package.json did not include babel-preset-expo even though babel.config.js requires it. This must be added explicitly.

lib/offline.js statically imports expo-sqlite at module top; since Expo Router preloads all routes, this brings down the entire web bundle. Use Metro platform extensions (.web.js / .native.js) — now done as a stopgap.

success_rate.frontend: ~15% (login screen renders; auth submission blocked by SecureStore web error; all downstream flows unreachable)

seed_data_creation: Attempted to create TEST_Driver_<ts> via admin → manage-drivers, but never reached dashboard due to SecureStore blocker. No seed data created on the live backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login screen now renders on Expo Web after the two fixes above. The blocker is expo-secure-store: clicking SIGN IN surfaces 'ExpoSecureStore.default.getValueWithKeyAsync is not a function' in the red login-error banner (visible in screenshot). Once main agent adds a web shim for SecureStore (or downgrades to ~15.0.8), restart expo, clear .metro-cache, then re-run the full flow: admin login → dashboard testIDs → manage-drivers create driver (capture emp_id/PIN from Alert dialog — playwright dialog handler works) → signout → driver login → driver-home. The page.on('dialog') pattern in the previous scripts captures Alert.alert messages on web.
rca_of_issue: Three cascading SDK-54 ↔ package-version mismatches: (1) babel-preset-expo absent → bundler can't transform any file; (2) expo-sqlite@55 ships a wa-sqlite.wasm path not resolvable on web → static import in lib/offline.js (preloaded by Expo Router) breaks the whole web bundle; (3) expo-secure-store@55 native-binding shape differs from web shim → SecureStore.getItemAsync throws at runtime inside axios request interceptor → every authenticated API call (including /auth/admin/login itself, which calls the interceptor) fails before hitting the network. Mitigation: align packages with `npx expo install --check` versions, or add Platform.OS-aware shims.
